sloka: लंका नाम समुद्रस्य मध्ये मम महापुरी ।सागरेण परिक्षिप्ता निविष्टा गिरि मूर्धनि ॥३-४७-२९॥
transliteration: laṁkā nāma samudrasya madhye mama mahāpurī ।sāgareṇa parikṣiptā niviṣṭā giri mūrdhani ॥3-47-29॥

translations.english: My great city called Lanka is on the peak of a mountain surrounded by, and in the middle of, the sea.
